pages.text: Pass the laboratory and isolation rooms. Open the sample chest beside the ice. Take the virus samples and convoy manifest. The exposed redstone line in the west lab can supply dust for the decoder.

Use a sample aimed at the ground beside you, away from your base. When the vial shatters nearby, switch to Prototype mode. The first release also starts the world's outbreak clock.$(br2)$(l:consume)Try your first consume$(/l)
